Book1/Prop01/Main.lean::proposition_1.sig: ∀ (a b : Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB → ∃ c : Point, |(c─a)| = |(a─b)| ∧ |(c─b)| = |(a─b)|

Book1/Prop02/Main.lean::proposition_2.sig: ∀ (a b c : Point) (BC : Line), (distinctPointsOnLine b c BC) ∧ (a ≠ b) → ∃ l : Point, |(a─l)| = |(b─c)|

Book1/Prop03/Main.lean::proposition_3.sig: ∀ (a b c₀ c₁ : Point) (AB C : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c₀ c₁ C ∧ |(a─b)| > |(c₀─c₁)| → ∃ e : Point, between a e b ∧ |(a─e)| = |(c₀─c₁)|

Book1/Prop04/Main.lean::proposition_4.sig: ∀ (a b c d e f : Point) (AB BC AC DE EF DF : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d e f DE EF DF ∧ |(a─b)| = |(d─e)| ∧ |(a─c)| = |(d─f)| ∧ (∠ b:a:c = ∠ e:d:f) → |(b─c)| = |(e─f)| ∧ (∠ a:b:c = ∠ d:e:f) ∧ (∠ a:c:b = ∠ d:f:e)

Book1/Prop05/Main.lean::proposition_5.sig: ∀ (a b c d e : Point) (AB BC AC : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (|(a─b)| = |(a─c)|) ∧ (between a b d) ∧ (between a c e) → (∠ a:b:c = ∠ a:c:b) ∧ (∠ c:b:d = ∠ b:c:e)

Book1/Prop06/Main.lean::proposition_6.sig: ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (∠ a:b:c = ∠ a:c:b) → |(a─b)| = |(a─c)|

Book1/Prop07/Main.lean::proposition_7.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB AC CB AD DB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a c AC ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c b CB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a d AD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine d b DB ∧ (c.sameSide d AB) ∧ c ≠ d ∧ (|(a─c)| = |(a─d)|) ∧ (|(c─b)| = |(d─b)|) → False

Book1/Prop08/Main.lean::proposition_8.sig: ∀ (a b c d e f : Point) (AB BC AC DE EF DF : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d e f DE EF DF ∧ |(a─b)| = |(d─e)| ∧ |(a─c)| = |(d─f)| ∧ |(b─c)| = |(e─f)| → ∠ b:a:c = ∠ e:d:f

Book1/Prop09/Main.lean::proposition_9.sig: ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB AC : Line), formRectilinearAngle b a c AB AC ∧ AB ≠ AC → ∃ f : Point, f ≠ a ∧ (∠ b:a:f = ∠ c:a:f)

Book1/Prop10/Main.lean::proposition_10.sig: ∀ (a b : Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB → ∃ d : Point, (between a d b) ∧ (|(a─d)| = |(d─b)|)

Book1/Prop11/Main.lean::proposition_11.sig: ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ between a c b → exists f : Point, ¬(f.onLine AB) ∧ (∠ a:c:f = ∟)

Book1/Prop12/Main.lean::proposition_12.sig: ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ ¬(c.onLine AB) → exists h : Point, h.onLine AB ∧ (∠ a:h:c = ∟ ∨ ∠ b:h:c = ∟) ∧ (∀ (p : Point), p.onLine AB → p ≠ h → ∠ p:h:c = ∟)

Book1/Prop13/Main.lean::proposition_13.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB CD : Line), AB ≠ CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧ between d b c → ∠ c:b:a + ∠ a:b:d = ∟ + ∟

Book1/Prop14/Main.lean::proposition_14.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC BD : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b c BC ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b d BD ∧ (c.opposingSides d AB) ∧ (∠ a:b:c + ∠ a:b:d) = ∟ + ∟ → BC = BD

Book1/Prop15/Main.lean::proposition_15.sig: ∀ (a b c d e : Point) (AB CD : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧ e.onLine AB ∧ e.onLine CD ∧ CD ≠ AB ∧ (between d e c) ∧ (between a e b) → (∠ a:e:c = ∠ d:e:b) ∧ (∠ c:e:b = ∠ a:e:d)

Book1/Prop16/Main.lean::proposition_16.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC: Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (between b c d) → (∠ a:c:d > ∠ c:b:a) ∧ (∠ a:c:d > ∠ b:a:c)

Book1/Prop17/Main.lean::proposition_17.sig: ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC → ∠ a:b:c + ∠ b:c:a < ∟ + ∟

Book1/Prop18/Main.lean::proposition_18.sig: ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (|(a─c)| > |(a─b)|) → (∠ a:b:c > ∠ b:c:a)

Book1/Prop19/Main.lean::proposition_19.sig: ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (∠ a:b:c > ∠ b:c:a) → (|(a─c)| > |(a─b)|)

Book1/Prop20/Main.lean::proposition_20.sig: ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC → |(b─a)| + |(a─c)| > |(b─c)| ∧ |(a─b)| + |(b─c)| > |(a─c)| ∧ |(b─c)| + |(c─a)| > |(a─b)|

Book1/Prop21/Main.lean::proposition_21.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC BD DC : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (a.sameSide d BC) ∧ (c.sameSide d AB) ∧ (b.sameSide d AC) ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b d BD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine d c DC → (|(b─d)| + |(d─c)| < |(b─a)| + |(a─c)|) ∧ (∠ b:d:c > ∠ b:a:c)

Book1/Prop22/Main.lean::proposition_22.sig: ∀ (a a' b b' c c' : Point) (A B C : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a a' A ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b b' B ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c c' C ∧ (|(a─a')| + |(b─b')| > |(c─c')|) ∧ (|(a─a')| + |(c─c')| > |(b─b')|) ∧ (|(b─b')| + |(c─c')| > |(a─a')|) → ∃ (k f g : Point), (|(f─k)| = |(a─a')|) ∧ (|(f─g)| = |(b─b')|) ∧ (|(k─g)| = |(c─c')|)

Book1/Prop23/Main.lean::proposition_23.sig: ∀ (a b c d e : Point) (AB CD CE : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ formRectilinearAngle d c e CD CE → ∃ f : Point, f ≠ a ∧ (∠ f:a:b = ∠ d:c:e)

Book1/Prop24/Main.lean::proposition_24.sig: ∀ (a b c d e f : Point) (AB BC AC DE EF DF : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d e f DE EF DF ∧ (|(a─b)| = |(d─e)|) ∧ (|(a─c)| = |(d─f)|) ∧ (∠ b:a:c > ∠ e:d:f) → |(b─c)| > |(e─f)|

Book1/Prop25/Main.lean::proposition_25.sig: ∀ (a b c d e f : Point) (AB BC AC DE EF DF : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d e f DE EF DF ∧ (|(a─b)| = |(d─e)|) ∧ (|(a─c)| = |(d─f)|) ∧ (|(b─c)| > |(e─f)|) → (∠ b:a:c > ∠ e:d:f)

Book1/Prop26/Main.lean::proposition_26.sig: ∀ (a b c d e f : Point) (AB BC AC DE EF DF : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d e f DE EF DF ∧ (∠ a:b:c = ∠ d:e:f) ∧ (∠ b:c:a = ∠ e:f:d) ∧ (|(b─c)| = |(e─f)| ∨ |(a─b)| = |(d─e)|) → (|(a─b)| = |(d─e)|) ∧ (|(b─c)| = |(e─f)|) ∧ (|(a─c)| = |(d─f)|) ∧ (∠ b:a:c = ∠ e:d:f)

Book1/Prop27/Main.lean::proposition_27.sig: ∀ (a d e f : Point) (AE FD EF : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a e AE ∧ distinctPointsOnLine f d FD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine e f EF ∧ a.opposingSides d EF ∧ (∠ a:e:f = ∠ e:f:d) → ¬(AE.intersectsLine FD)

Book1/Prop28/Main.lean::proposition_28.sig: ∀ (a b c d e f g h : Point) (AB CD EF : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine e f EF ∧ (between a g b) ∧ (between c h d) ∧ (between e g h) ∧ (between g h f) ∧ (b.sameSide d EF) ∧ (∠ e:g:b = ∠ g:h:d ∨ ∠ b:g:h + ∠ g:h:d = ∟ + ∟) → ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD)

Book1/Prop29/Main.lean::proposition_29.sig: ∀ (a b c d e f g h : Point) (AB CD EF : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine e f EF ∧ (between a g b) ∧ (between c h d) ∧ (between e g h) ∧ (between g h f) ∧ (b.sameSide d EF) ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD) → ∠ a:g:h = ∠ g:h:d ∧ ∠ e:g:b = ∠ g:h:d ∧ ∠ b:g:h + ∠ g:h:d = ∟ + ∟

Book1/Prop30/Main.lean::proposition_30.sig: ∀ (AB CD EF : Line), AB ≠ CD ∧ CD ≠ EF ∧ EF ≠ AB ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine EF) ∧ ¬(CD.intersectsLine EF) → ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD)

Book1/Prop31/Main.lean::proposition_31.sig: ∀ (a b c : Point) (BC : Line), distinctPointsOnLine b c BC ∧ ¬(a.onLine BC) → ∃ EF : Line, a.onLine EF ∧ ¬(EF.intersectsLine BC)

Book1/Prop32/Main.lean::proposition_32.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ (between b c d) → ∠ a:c:d = ∠ c:a:b + ∠ a:b:c ∧ ∠ a:b:c + ∠ b:c:a + ∠ c:a:b = ∟ + ∟

Book1/Prop33/Main.lean::proposition_33.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB CD AC BD : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a c AC ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b d BD ∧ (a.sameSide c BD) ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD) ∧ |(a─b)| = |(c─d)| → AC ≠ BD ∧ ¬(AC.intersectsLine BD) ∧ |(a─c)|= |(b─d)|

Book1/Prop34/Main.lean::proposition_34.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB CD AC BD BC : Line), formParallelogram a b c d AB CD AC BD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b c BC → |(a─b)| = |(c─d)| ∧ |(a─c)| = |(b─d)| ∧ ∠ a:b:d = ∠ a:c:d ∧ ∠ b:a:c = ∠ c:d:b ∧ Triangle.area △ a:b:c = Triangle.area △ d:c:b

Book1/Prop35/Main.lean::proposition_35.sig: ∀ (a b c d e f g : Point) (AF BC AB CD EB FC : Line), formParallelogram a d b c AF BC AB CD ∧ formParallelogram e f b c AF BC EB FC ∧ between a d e ∧ between d e f ∧ g.onLine CD ∧ g.onLine EB → Triangle.area △a:b:d + Triangle.area △d:b:c = Triangle.area △e:b:c + Triangle.area △ e:c:f

Book1/Prop36/Main.lean::proposition_36.sig: ∀ (a b c d e f g h : Point) (AH BG AB CD EF HG : Line), formParallelogram a d b c AH BG AB CD ∧ formParallelogram e h f g AH BG EF HG ∧ |(b─c)| = |(f─g)| ∧ (between a d h) ∧ (between a e h) → Triangle.area △ a:b:d + Triangle.area △ d:b:c = Triangle.area △ e:f:h + Triangle.area △ h:f:g

Book1/Prop37/Main.lean::proposition_37.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC BD CD AD : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d b c BD BC CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a d AD ∧ ¬(AD.intersectsLine BC) ∧ d.sameSide c AB → Triangle.area △ a:b:c = Triangle.area △ d:b:c

Book1/Prop38/Main.lean::proposition_38.sig: ∀ (a b c d e f: Point) (AD BF AB AC DE DF : Line), a.onLine AD ∧ d.onLine AD ∧ formTriangle a b c AB BF AC ∧ formTriangle d e f DE BF DF ∧ ¬(AD.intersectsLine BF) ∧ (between b c f) ∧ (between b e f) ∧ |(b─c)| = |(e─f)| → Triangle.area △ a:b:c = Triangle.area △ d:e:f

Book1/Prop39/Main.lean::proposition_39.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC BD CD AD : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d b c BD BC CD ∧ a.sameSide d BC ∧ (△ a:b:c : ℝ) = (△ d:b:c) ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a d AD → ¬(AD.intersectsLine BC)

Book1/Prop40/Main.lean::proposition_40.sig: ∀ (a b c d e : Point) (AB BC AC CD DE AD : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d c e CD BC DE ∧ a.sameSide d BC ∧ b ≠ e ∧ |(b─c)| = |(c─e)| ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a d AD ∧ (Triangle.area △ a:b:c = Triangle.area △ d:c:e) → ¬(AD.intersectsLine BC)

Book1/Prop41/Main.lean::proposition_41.sig: ∀ (a b c d e : Point) (AE BC AB CD BE CE : Line), formParallelogram a d b c AE BC AB CD ∧ formTriangle e b c BE BC CE ∧ e.onLine AE ∧ ¬(AE.intersectsLine BC) → (Triangle.area △ a:b:c : ℝ) + (Triangle.area △ a:c:d) = (Triangle.area △ e:b:c) + (Triangle.area △ e :b :c)

Book1/Prop42/Main.lean::proposition_42.sig: ∀ (a b c d₁ d₂ d₃ : Point) (AB BC AC D₁₂ D₂₃: Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃ ∧ (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) > 0 ∧ (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟ → ∃ (f g e c' : Point) (FG EC EF CG : Line), formParallelogram f g e c' FG EC EF CG ∧ (∠ c':e:f = ∠ d₁:d₂:d₃) ∧ (Triangle.area △ f:e:c' + Triangle.area △ f:c':g = Triangle.area △ a:b:c)

Book1/Prop43/Main.lean::proposition_43.sig: ∀ (a b c d e f g h k : Point) (AD BC AB CD AC EF GH : Line), formParallelogram a d b c AD BC AB CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a c AC ∧ k.onLine AC ∧ between a h d ∧ formParallelogram a h e k AD EF AB GH ∧ formParallelogram k f g c EF BC GH CD → (Triangle.area △ e:b:g + Triangle.area △ e:g:k = Triangle.area △ h:k:f + Triangle.area △ h:f:d)

Book1/Prop45/Main.lean::proposition_45.sig: ∀ (a b c d e₁ e₂ e₃ : Point) (AB BC CD AD DB E₁₂ E₂₃ : Line), formTriangle a b d AB DB AD ∧ formTriangle b c d BC CD DB ∧ a.opposingSides c DB ∧ formRectilinearAngle e₁ e₂ e₃ E₁₂ E₂₃ ∧ ∠ e₁:e₂:e₃ > 0 ∧ ∠ e₁:e₂:e₃ < ∟ + ∟ → ∃ (f l k m : Point) (FL KM FK LM : Line), formParallelogram f l k m FL KM FK LM ∧ (∠ f:k:m = ∠ e₁:e₂:e₃) ∧ (Triangle.area △ f:k:m + Triangle.area △ f:l:m = Triangle.area △ a:b:d + Triangle.area △ d:b:c)

Book2/Prop04/Main.lean::proposition_4.sig: ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ between a c b → |(a─b)| * |(a─b)| = |(a─c)| * |(a─c)| + |(c─b)| * |(c─b)| + 2 * (|(a─c)| * |(c─b)|)

Book2/Prop06/Main.lean::proposition_6.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ c.onLine AB ∧ d.onLine AB ∧ between a c b ∧ |(a─c)| = |(c─b)| ∧ between a b d → |(a─d)| * |(d─b)| + |(c─b)| * |(c─b)| = |(c─d)| * |(c─d)|

Book2/Prop07/Main.lean::proposition_7.sig: ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ between a c b → |(a─b)| * |(a─b)| + |(b─c)| * |(b─c)| = 2 * (|(a─b)| * |(b─c)|) + |(c─a)| * |(c─a)|

Book2/Prop09/Main.lean::proposition_9.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ c.onLine AB ∧ d.onLine AB ∧ between a c b ∧ |(a─c)| = |(c─b)| ∧ between c d b → |(a─d)| * |(a─d)| + |(d─b)| * |(d─b)| = 2 * (|(a─c)| * |(a─c)| + |(c─d)| * |(c─d)|)

Book2/Prop10/Main.lean::proposition_10.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AD : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a d AD ∧ c.onLine AD ∧ b.onLine AD ∧ between a c b ∧ between a b d ∧ |(a─c)| = |(c─b)| → |(a─d)| * |(a─d)| + |(d─b)| * |(d─b)| = 2 * (|(a─c)| * |(a─c)| + |(c─d)| * |(c─d)|)

Book2/Prop12/Main.lean::proposition_12.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC CA : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC CA ∧ (∠ b:a:c : ℝ) > ∟ ∧ d.onLine CA ∧ between d a c ∧ (∠ b:d:c : ℝ) = ∟ → |(b─c)| * |(b─c)| = |(b─a)| * |(b─a)| + |(a─c)| * |(a─c)| + 2 * (|(c─a)| * |(a─d)|)

Book2/Prop13/Main.lean::proposition_13.sig: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC CA : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC CA ∧ (∠ a:b:c : ℝ) < ∟ ∧ (∠ b:c:a : ℝ) < ∟ ∧ (∠ c:a:b : ℝ) < ∟ ∧ d.onLine BC ∧ between b d c ∧ (∠ a:d:c : ℝ) = ∟ → |(a─c)| * |(a─c)| + 2 * (|(c─b)| * |(b─d)|) = |(c─b)| * |(c─b)| + |(b─a)| * |(b─a)|
